title: Clear the free backlog — every item that is startable now at zero compute cost
note: Five route-level next actions cost nothing and are startable today: run the induced-proximity reach enumeration with a transcriptional-effector terminus; regenerate the junction-neoantigen predictions against the corrected exon index; state the selectivity requirement the monovalent route would have to meet; build an exposure criterion that passes its own positive control; resolve the primary citation for the only ex-vivo EMC evidence in the repository. ⭐ Four of these were sitting on a literature WATCH LIST as things to wait for, where they were invisible. They are work, not waiting.

title: Resolve the one blocker that costs a conversation rather than a capability
note: The program's only binary selectivity known-answer control is built, staged and has never been run. Nothing failed and nothing is missing — it is waiting on a person. It is the cheapest open blocker in the register and it gates whether the program's central quantitative claim is measurable at all. Registered as BLK-SELECTIVITY-CONTROL-UNAUTHORIZED, a kind that had no members until the taxonomy was built.

title: Publish the three deliverables that no blocker holds down
note: The methods paper on the program's own failure record has NO scientific blocker at all — it is finished when the writing stops, and it is the portfolio's floor: the outcome that holds even if every family fails. The junction-oligonucleotide arc is computationally complete with delivery named honestly as its gate. The replication-stress assessment is complete on its own axis with its class-inheritance limit stated inside it. ⚠ Publishing is also the mechanism that recruits the collaborator every wet-lab-gated row depends on, so it is not a parallel track — it is the unblocking step for fourteen other rows.

title: Close the five technology dependencies nothing is scanning for
note: Five registered dependencies have no literature query, so they could land without anyone noticing — which makes their forecasts unfalsifiable in practice. Adding a query to the scan registry is free. The generated technology view flags them on every render until they are closed.

title: Structure prediction reaches induced-complex ASSEMBLY
note: The highest-fan-out capability with an `evidence_based` forecast. One arm has already landed — high inter-chain accuracy WHEN BOTH SITES ARE GIVEN — so what is expected here is assembly from sequence and ligand alone, plus the benchmark discipline of reporting inter-chain rather than per-chain accuracy on post-training-horizon structures. ⚠ In-horizon results are memorisation-permitting by construction and move nothing.

title: Cheap conformational ensembles become calibrated, not merely available
note: The detection arm landed in 2026 and is already in production use here. What is expected is calibration on rare-open populations — which is what would turn a qualitative cross-check into a population estimate, and what decides whether a proteome-scale cryptic-pocket survey is feasible.

title: Autonomous research agents hold a multi-month thread with acceptable provenance
note: Partly landed already: agents run this repository's compute lanes, monitoring and document generation. The gap is durability and judgement over months, not raw capability — and this repository has direct evidence of that gap, because a scheduled agent task credited in two of its own documents has never produced an entry. ⭐ This is one of the few dependencies observable from inside rather than inferred from literature, which makes its forecast unusually checkable.

title: A free-energy method validated on cryptic and induced-fit pockets
note: ⭐ The single highest-fan-out dependency in the portfolio, and the one that decides whether the program's central quantitative claim is ever measurable. Until it lands, every absolute free-energy number on the binder path is uninterpretable — the engine misses a known answer by more than the entire margin it is asked to resolve, and that is an ACCURACY problem, not a scale one, so more compute does not substitute.

title: Perturbation models predict held-out phenotype in an untrained cell type
note: The route by which EMC's data poverty stops being binding without any EMC data being generated: a model that generalises to an untrained cell type could ask the fusion-dependence question — the make-or-break premise beneath the degrader and the oligonucleotide routes alike — which this program currently delegates entirely. ⚠ This is where defaulting to conservative assumptions bites hardest; foundation-model progress in adjacent domains has repeatedly outrun conservative forecasts, and the expected band reflects that deliberately.

title: Re-grade completed work against the capability level of the day
note: A completed result is a snapshot at a capability level, not a permanent fact. This is a standing milestone rather than a task: when a dependency lands, the work it touches is re-run rather than merely cited. ⚠ Guardrail, unchanged: a coming capability justifies waiting and re-running — it never licences claiming the result before the method can support it.

title: Bench access becomes reachable — by collaborator or by robot
note: ⭐ The milestone that would flip the program's FOUNDING CONSTRAINT — that no wet lab is available, so every step must be in-silico or publish-to-convince. Fourteen routes are held by the access blocker, more than any other. Two independent paths: a self-interested collaborator (which a convincing preprint is what buys), or a cloud lab reaching solo-affordable pricing with the right assay scope. ⚠ They are NOT interchangeable — a cloud lab supplies robots and generic reagents, never the EMC cell line, so it flips the execution gate and not automatically the material gate.

title: Public EMC functional-genomics or expression data exists
note: The repository-wide rate-limiter, holding fifteen routes — more than any method blocker. It is a DATA dependency, not a method one, and it is the least controllable item on this roadmap: it depends on a group collecting a series and choosing to deposit it. Nine routes re-grade automatically when it lands, which is why the model records them explicitly rather than leaving the fan-out to be re-derived.

title: An oligonucleotide delivery route to a non-hepatic solid tumour
note: The one remaining gate on the most structurally sound route in the portfolio — the only genuinely fusion-selective one. ⭐ The higher-value observation is not a delivery platform but a characterised EMC-enriched surface antigen to serve as a targeting arm: with one, existing conjugate chemistry may suffice. That is a discovery event rather than an engineering one and could happen at any time, which is why the optimistic band is much earlier than the expected one.

title: Solid-tumour vector delivery at therapeutic coverage
note: The slowest delivery problem and the one three genetic routes wait on. Kept strictly separate from oligonucleotide delivery: different engineering problems with different candidate solutions, and merging them would let one arriving imply the other had.

title: Standing: re-run the priority ordering whenever a dependency changes state
note: This roadmap is a projection of the technology register, not an independent plan — so it changes when the register does, and a landed capability re-orders the portfolio automatically rather than by anyone remembering to. ⚠ Every forecast carries `last_reviewed`, and one older than two quarters is flagged rather than silently trusted. A roadmap nobody re-grades is a roadmap that describes the year it was written.
